annotations.title: What the by-laws say on a subject in a South African place

description: Find the sections of a South African municipality's by-laws and zoning scheme on one subject — e.g. "boundary wall height", "second dwelling", "home business", "keeping chickens", "building line", "signage", "noise" — and quote their wording with the by-law title, section number, status and official link. Read a whole section with legal_get_section (doc_id + section). Repealed by-laws are left out.

place.description: Town, suburb or municipality name, or a municipal code (e.g. "WC043")

subject.description: The subject in a few plain words (e.g. "boundary wall height")

topic.description: Optional: search only by-laws of this topic
